1.w: Of David. Blessed [be] YHWH, my Rock, the One training my hands for war, my fingers for battle—

2.w: my steadfast One and my fortress, my tower and my deliverer—for me; my shield in whom I take refuge, the One subduing the peoples under me.

3.w: O YHWH, what [is] man that You take knowledge of him, the son of man that You think of him?

4.w: Man is like a breath; his days [are] like a shadow passing by.

5.w: O YHWH, bend Your heavens and come down! Touch the mountains, that they may smoke!

6.w: Flash lightning and scatter them; send forth Your arrows and rout them!

7.w: Stretch out Your hand from on high; release me and deliver me from the great waters, from the hand of sons of a foreigner,

8.w: whose mouth has spoken emptiness, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood.

9.w: O God, let me sing a new song to You; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—

10.w: the One giving salvation to kings, the One releasing David His servant from the sword of evil.

11.w: May You release me and snatch me from the hand of the sons of a foreigner, whose mouth speaks emptiness, and their right hand [is] a right hand of deception.

12.w: That our sons [may be] as plants grown up in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars, carved [for] the pattern of the palace.

13.w: Our granaries full, bringing out from kind to kind, our flocks producing thousands, being myriads in our fields,

14.w: our oxen carrying. Let there be no breach, and no going forth, and no an outcry in our wide streets.

15.w: Blessed [are] the people for whom [is] thus; blessed [are] the people for whom YHWH [is] God!
